clusters.name: Teodor's death, 1978–1979
clusters.reason: Around your grandfather Teodor's death in January 1978, within the following year: your grandmother Delphine stopped cooking and went to your mother's every evening, your father took night shifts and kept his distance from your mother, your uncle Anton drank at lunch and was warned at work, his wife Celeste left him in August, your mother lay awake over them, and your brother Callum had ear infections all winter. Your grandmother took a job at the library by May 1979, and the shifts settled.

clusters.name: Odette's bed rest, 1984
clusters.reason: Around your mother being ordered to bed for the rest of her pregnancy in March 1984, within five months: your grandmother Hazel came every morning to keep the house, your father argued with her over how she kept it, your brother Callum stammered again, and your sister Ines was born in September. The shifts settled once Ines arrived and the immediate crisis passed.

clusters.name: Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis, 1986–1997
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Hazel's Parkinson's diagnosis in September 1986, within the following eleven years: your grandfather Ambrose took over her cooking and appointments, your father phoned his father every night for news of her, Hazel had a bad fall in 1988 and could no longer dress herself by 1991, your father and uncle Lyle argued over who should help their parents, your grandfather had chest pains, your mother took Hazel to the clinic twice a week, your aunt Mavis came to stay to nurse her sister, your father drank most evenings, your aunt Pearl had panic spells at the wheel, Hazel could no longer stand by 1995, your grandfather gave up his workshop and hardly left her side, your father fought with your mother over his evenings at his parents' house, and your father cut his drinking back once Hazel moved to the nursing home in June 1997. The shifts settled after that move.

clusters.name: Callum's move north, 1999–2000
clusters.reason: Around your brother Callum leaving home for a job up north in May 1999, within the following year: your father and Callum argued most nights over his plans, your mother could not settle at the thought of him so far away, your father missed days at work and sat up late in the garage, your sister Ines skipped school most of that autumn, your mother took Ines with her everywhere including to work, and Ines was back at school full days by August 2000 and passed her exams. The shifts settled once Ines returned to school.

clusters.name: Hazel's death, 2003
clusters.reason: Around your grandmother Hazel's death in January 2003, within the following nine months: you could not sleep more than a few hours a night, stopped going to the bookshop and were let go in May, dreaded buses and crowded shops and went out only after dark, and took a job at the garden centre by November and slept through the night again. Every shift in these months is yours, and no one else's shows then.
